findings.text: Authors say thoughtful validation of safety, performance, and reliability remains critical for downstream medical applications, but report no safety eval numbers.

source.quote:
thoughtful validation of safety, performance, and reliability for any downstream applications
remains a critical aspect to advance the use of multimodal AI models in medicine.

findings.text: Authors note that strong scores on public medical benchmarks may partly reflect test data leakage.

source.quote:
raises the possibility of test data leakage, as these benchmarks are publicly available and frequently
used in model development and evaluation.

findings.text: Authors state that automated medical benchmarks are only a first step and have limitations for real-world utility.

limitations exist for these benchmarks. For one, automated benchmarks represent only the first

findings.text: Evaluation used only public datasets because of data privacy and license terms.

findings.text: MedGemma 4B and Gemma 3 4B struggled to follow AgentClinic system instructions in the agentic setup.

the 4B variants

notes: Technical report (arXiv 2507.05201), not a system card. No dedicated safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, privacy-of-the-model, or dangerous-capability section or numeric results; evalResults left empty per pilot safety-only rule. Skipped all capability medical and general benchmarks (MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, MMLU Med, MedXpertQA, AfriMed-QA, AgentClinic, SLAKE, VQA-RAD, MIMIC-CXR classification and report generation, CheXpert, CXR14, Path/Derm MCQA, EyePACS, EHRQA, Table 12 general benchmarks, MedSigLIP AUCs, Table A14, and related figures). Covers includes MedSigLIP (rawModelName) because the report introduces and evaluates it as a released Google model; seed did not link it. MedGemma 27B multimodal is also released (Appendix F) under the same family as google/medgemma-27b-it; report default MedGemma 27B is text-only (checkpoint google/medgemma-27b-text-it). No calendar model release date—only that models were released openly. TPU training mentioned without FLOPs so trainingCompute not_stated.
